description: This file contains utility functions and classes for PyTorch pipeline parallelism, including tensor shape validation, tensor flattening, and stage-to-rank mappings in distributed training.

classes.name: PipeliningShapeError
classes.description: Custom runtime error indicating shape or dtype mismatches in tensor validation.

classes.name: PipeInfo
classes.description: Data class capturing information related to a pipeline segment, including a FX graph, number of stages, and a flag for loss and backward computation.

methods.name: flatten_args_detach(args)
methods.description: Flattens args into a list and detaches tensors from the computational graph, returning new args and detached tensor list.

methods.name: flatten_args(args)
methods.description: Flattens args into a list without detaching tensors.

methods.name: validate_tensor_metadata(desc, expected, given)
methods.description: Validates shape, dtype, and stride of a tensor against expected metadata.

methods.name: validate_tensors_metadata( desc, expected_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], actual_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], )
methods.description: Validates a list or tuple of tensors against expected metadata for each tensor.

methods.name: dict[int,int] generate_stage_to_rank_mapping( pp_size: int, num_stages: int, style: str = "loop" )
methods.description: Generates a mapping of stage indices to rank IDs based on a specified schedule style ('loop' or 'v').

methods.name: dict[int,list[int]] generate_rank_to_stage_mapping( pp_size: int, num_stages: int, style: str = "loop" )
methods.description: Generates a mapping from rank IDs to lists of stage indices assigned to each rank, inverting the stage-to-rank map.

ctags.name: generate_rank_to_stage_mapping
ctags.signature: ( pp_size: int, num_stages: int, style: str = "loop" )

ctags.name: generate_stage_to_rank_mapping
ctags.signature: ( pp_size: int, num_stages: int, style: str = "loop" )

ctags.name: validate_tensors_metadata
ctags.signature: ( desc, expected_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], actual_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], )
